surfaceMeaning: Standard grid on a source-informed shape model; no resolved global surface map.
name: Máni
credit: Rommel et al. (2023), A&A 678, A167; nine stellar-occultation campaigns
shapeMeaning: Silhouette-constrained oblate approximation: the observed 824 × 770 km projected ellipse is represented by full axes 824 × 824 × 770 km. The equal equatorial depth and equator-on interpretation are assumptions; true flattening may be larger.
orientationMeaning: Illustrative pole RA 0°, declination 90° and arbitrary meridian; the occultation position angle does not determine an inertial spin pole.
periodText: Unresolved; published alternatives include 7.33 and 10.44 hours
introduction: Formerly 2002 MS4, Máni has an outline measured through many stellar occultations. One event revealed a large depression along its edge, but its global terrain and three-dimensional shape remain unresolved.

numericEvidence.section: Rommel et al. (2023), 2020 August 8 ellipse fit and section 4
numericEvidence.axisOrdering: The two equal 824 km full axes are the assumed equator; the 770 km full axis is the minimum-flattening polar interpretation of the projected limb.
numericEvidence.radiusFormula: cbrt(412 * 412 * 385); model volume radius, distinct from the measured area-equivalent radius 398 km
numericEvidence.namingReference: WGSBN Bulletin 5(11), 2025 June 9, page 13: (307261) Máni = 2002 MS4

unresolved: The occultations measure projected limbs, not depth; true oblateness and spin pole remain unresolved.
Observed limb depressions are not a global elevation map and are not extruded around the model.
Rotational period alternatives and doubled aliases are unresolved.

sourceSurvey.provides: Measured elliptical silhouette and local limb features
sourceSurvey.reason: Numeric silhouette anchors the smooth assumed-depth model. No crater or limb-feature extrusion.

sourceSurvey.provides: Same study’s thermal-size comparison and preference for an oblate interpretation
sourceSurvey.reason: Thermal size is not substituted for the directly observed outline; the pole and true flattening remain undetermined.
